About Neon Brick Breaker

An electrifying homage to Breakout and Arkanoid. Control your paddle, angle your ball bounces, shatter reinforced neon blocks, and grab falling power-up capsules like Wide Paddle, Multi-Ball, and Slow Ball.

📖 How to Play

  • 1Keep the ball bouncing off your paddle to prevent it from dropping into the void.
  • 2Different brick colors require 1, 2, or 3 hits to shatter.
  • 3Catch falling capsules to activate game-changing powerups.
  • 4Clear all destroyable bricks to advance to the next level.

💡 Pro Tips & Winning Strategies

  • ✦Hit the ball with the outer edges of the paddle to achieve sharp, high-speed bounce angles.
  • ✦Try to bounce the ball over the top of the brick layer to let it ricochet repeatedly behind enemy lines.

🎮 Controls & Shortcuts

Input / KeyAction Description
Mouse Move / Touch DragMove paddle horizontally across screen
Left / Right Arrow KeysKeyboard paddle movement
Spacebar / ClickLaunch initial ball or fire laser

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

How many levels are included in Neon Brick Breaker?▼

The game features 10 escalating procedural levels with unique block patterns and brick hardness.
